Position Overview/Mandate:
The Senior Signal Integrity and Power Integrity Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring the performance, reliability, and compliance of high-speed electronic systems designed by Fidus. You will lead and support SI/PI analysis from early architecture through final validation, working closely with hardware designers, PCB layout, FPGA, and system teams to optimize signal quality and power distribution.

• Hands-on experience with high-speed interfaces such as DDR memory and SERDES

• Solid lab validation experience using tools such as TDR, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and high-speed oscilloscopes

• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with customers and cross-functional teams

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Introduction to the team:

SandboxAQ’s medical device team, AQMed, is building a magnetic sensing device to transform cardiac sensing. By measuring the heart’s magnetic field, a sensing modality known as magnetocardiography, we can gain information about heart disease unavailable through existing sensing methods. Our first application of this technology will be to better triage patients with suspected heart attacks.

Introduction to the role:

The AQMed Team is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This role is central to our efforts to develop a machine learning model to detect high-risk coronary artery disease using magnetocardiographic data. In this role you will be responsible for developing predictive features and machine learning models that process biosignal data, processing and cleaning clinical study data, and supporting verification and validation of a software as a medical device (SaMD) product for regulatory submission. You will work with real multi-site clinical study data. As part of a small team, your models and biomarkers will directly shape our product and you will get hands-on experience bringing a new sensing modality to patients.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Engineer novel features that can be extracted from biosignal data, taking inspiration from the literature and your knowledge of cardiac electrophysiology, and train machine learning models to detect high risk coronary artery disease

- Own data quality and curation for clinical study datasets, from raw site exports to analysis-ready dataframes

- Run rigorous model evaluation and write V&V and regulatory documentation for a diagnostic medical device

- Collaborate with AQMed’s clinical operations, product, and engineering teams to support clinical studies, define ML system requirements, and deploy models into production in a cloud environment

ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Master’s or PhD in biomedical engineering, biophysics, machine learning, or a related field

- 5 years industry experience with biomedical signal processing and machine learning, including:

- classical machine learning in a data-scarce environment and

- experience shipping a commercial product

- Expertise in Python data science software tools (numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, PyTorch) and familiarity with cloud data processing tools (SQL, AWS)

- Working knowledge of ECG, cardiac electrophysiology, and quantitative biomedical research methods for diagnostics

HIGHLY DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Experience in the cardiac or neurological medical device industry

- Experience with medical device quality and regulatory requirements including FDA 510(k)/SaMD, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP)

- Experience with deep learning methods (e.g. self-supervised pretraining, transfer learning, distillation)

Over the last few months, a consultant improved our in-house design standards, style guide, review practices, and an early set of universal merchandising attributes. We are now hiring someone in-house to take that work over and grow it for the long term.
As our Catalog Taxonomist, you will be the expert on our taxonomy, information architecture, and catalog data model. You will serve as the catalog administrator, set and enforce catalog standards, and own catalog functionality enhancements from requirements definition and justification all the way through operational implementation. Reporting to the SVP of Merchandising Operations, you will partner closely with Operations, Product, Design, and Engineering, to make sure the catalog stays accurate, scalable, and easy to work in as we expand into new categories.
A large part of this job is working shoulder to shoulder with engineers and a product manager. You will sit with the Cat Crew R&D team, translate merchandising problems into requirements they can build against, and translate technical constraints back into business impact for the rest of the organization. Just as important, you will be the person who notices when the platform is quietly costing the team time or accuracy, names that gap clearly, sizes it, and advocates for fixing it.
The groundwork is fairly new, so you will have a solid base to start from and real room to decide where it goes next. You get to grow the skills of an already highly-motivated Merchandising team and make the group even stronger. You will also influence R&D strategy as we build and enhance our catalog software capabilities,and partner with our clinical division as we launch new categories together.
What You'll Do

• Own the standards and structure of the global product taxonomy, category hierarchy, and catalog data model, and evolve them as we expand into new categories.
